cache: OS filesystem/SQLite caches warm; no cache flush; each benchmark query warmed once
layout: 1000 immediate group directories, each 999 empty files; no deep path stress
threads: private Rayon pool, at most 4 workers for >=65536 entries; small indexes single-threaded; query/event loop serial
memory_metric: TASK_VM_INFO phys_footprint (current) and ledger_phys_footprint_peak (kernel lifetime peak); bytes
limitations: Public data are synthetic filenames only; private real-corpus records and Spotlight comparison output are retained locally.
Final query run occurred after incremental cleanup; 1,000,000 live entries plus retained tombstone slots.
query-overlapping-tasks.json overlapped compilation and other tests; not a controlled background stress benchmark.
Socket round trips use a Python client, not per-query CLI startup or graphical UI.
Single-file incremental changes in a directory of 999 existing files; full-rescan concurrent latency, deep paths, long names, content and models are not tested.
